anomalies.observed: On the schematic sheet, R7 (the pull resistor on the MAX3485 DE//RE enable node, tied between Q2's collector / U1 pins 2-3 and GND) is drawn with the value '20M'.
anomalies.expected: The specification's component table lists R7 as 20 kΩ ('R6, R7, R8, R15 | 2k, 20k, 2.2k, 2.2k'). A 20 kΩ pull-down is needed to define the DE//RE state when Q2 is off; 20 MΩ is ~1000× too large and leaves the enable node effectively floating.

evidence.quote: R7 20M (resistor below Q2 BC857 collector, connected to the U1 pin2/pin3 DE//RE line)
R6, R7, R8, R15 | 2k, 20k, 2.2k, 2.2k | Bias/pull network on the MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line.

anomalies.impact: With R7 at 20 MΩ the DE//RE node is not reliably pulled to its idle level when Q2 is non-conducting, so the MAX3485 direction control can float. In serial-servo mode the transceiver may fail to enable reception (or latch in one state), breaking the half-duplex auto-direction switching the design relies on.

parsed.summary: The board matches the specification in topology, part identities and most values, but R7 is drawn as 20 MΩ where the spec calls for 20 kΩ, leaving the MAX3485 DE//RE enable node essentially unpulled and jeopardising the auto TX/RX direction control used in serial-servo mode.
